review:
Sugar Rush 1000 takes the original cluster-pays candy slot to a 7×7 grid where five or more touching symbols win. Every win tumbles away and new symbols drop in, so a single spin can chain several payouts.

The key mechanic is the spot multiplier. Each exploding winning symbol marks its square; a second explosion there adds a 2x multiplier, which then doubles with every further hit, up to 1,024x. Multipliers under a winning cluster are applied to it. Pragmatic lists the RTP at 96.00%. It suits players who enjoy watching a grid build towards a big tumble, and who accept long quiet stretches in between.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
